notes: 'ish mokhiah is one unit under rule 30, the generic head noun and the participle naming the class being rendered by the single English word reprover, with the indefinite article going to that nominal expression (rule 15).
The resultative le- of s015 is unrepresented: the copula is already carried by the written hayah verb, so the preposition has no English left (rules 21, 40).
The waw of s008 is rendered by the subordinator that alone (rules 14, 55).
